dedupe_keys.name: shrp 2 naturalistic driving study insight data

description: The second Strategic Highway Research Program Naturalistic Driving Study (SHRP 2 NDS) records ordinary driving under real-world conditions to learn about driver decisions and the causes of crashes and near-crashes. The InSight website, run by the Virginia Tech Transportation Institute, describes more than 3,400 participating drivers and vehicles and holds over 5,400,000 trip summary records and more than 36,000 crash, near-crash and baseline driving events. Vehicles were fitted with cameras, radar and kinematic sensors, and users can query the database, build cross tabulations and view driver assessment, vehicle, trip and event data. Coverage is United States roads driven by the volunteer drivers. Access: free on InSight after registration or as a guest, with user access levels that govern how much detail is shown; the VTTI Dataverse entry, released 2018-03-08, is issued under a Data Use License. Caveats: the sample is volunteers from selected sites, so it is not a random sample of the driving population, and detailed data depend on the access level. It supports behavioural calibration of traffic and crash models, agent-based driver models and safety analyses, and complements the NGSIM vehicle trajectories and US Accidents records catalogued here.
